title: Ben Fong (Berkeley SkyDeck Head of BD) on hosting Eric for the fireside
summary: SkyDeck's Head of Business Development frames Eric's visit as a chance for SkyDeck founders to learn directly from one of the most influential voices in entrepreneurship.
blockquote:
From The Lean Startup to his latest book, Incorruptible, Eric Ries has shaped how generations of founders think about building enduring companies.

We were excited to host Eric at Berkeley SkyDeck for a fireside chat with our founders on founder-led governance, long-term company building, and preserving mission as startups scale.

A huge opportunity for our founders to learn directly from one of the most influential voices in entrepreneurship.
attribution_title: Head of Business Development, Berkeley SkyDeck
